harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL10, mariadb-server-galera 10.11.18) with an appdb.orders table holding application data. Performed a full cluster shutdown (all 3 nodes stopped) to simulate a maintenance window, then correctly restored it by bootstrapping the node with the highest grastate seqno (node1) via galera_new_cluster and rejoining node2/node3 via SST. All pre-maintenance committed writes survived and all three members served again post-recovery. Then, per the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol, restarted each node one at a time (native `reboot`), proved changed boot_id on each, and confirmed each node auto-rejoined the cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with all data intact after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (never restarting more than one node at a time).
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, galera, and mariadb-server-galera packages on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/hosts and /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf with wsrep cluster settings on all 3 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306, 4567/tcp+udp, 4568, 4444 on all 3 nodes
Bootstrapped Galera cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2 and node3 (SST via rsync)
Enabled mariadb systemd service on all 3 nodes for boot persistence
Created appdb.orders table and inserted baseline rows, verified replication across all 3 nodes
Inserted a pre-maintenance write, then performed a full cluster shutdown (stopped mariadb on node3, node2, node1 in sequence)
Identified node1 as having the highest grastate seqno (9, safe_to_bootstrap=1) and restored the cluster by bootstrapping node1 then starting node2 and node3
Verified all committed writes (5 rows) present on all nodes and cluster Primary/Synced with size 3
Wrote a post-maintenance row from node3 and confirmed instant replication to node1
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes
Sequentially restarted node2, node3, then node1 via native `reboot`, polling until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id on each node post-restart
Verified mariadb auto-started and rejoined Galera cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with all 5 rows intact after each individual node restart

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-node Galera cluster baseline with application data before maintenance
evidence.summary: Cluster size=3, Primary, Synced; appdb.orders rows including pre-maintenance write visible identically on node1, node2, node3

evidence.requirement: Complete cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped (inactive) on node3, node2, then node1 in sequence, resulting in full cluster outage

evidence.requirement: Correct restart procedure using most-advanced node's grastate seqno
evidence.summary: grastate.dat showed node1 seqno=9 (safe_to_bootstrap=1) highest of the three; node1 bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster

evidence.requirement: All committed writes present after cluster restore, all three members serving
evidence.summary: After node2/node3 rejoined, cluster size=3, Primary, Synced on all nodes; all 4 pre-maintenance rows present everywhere; new post-maintenance write from node3 replicated instantly to node1

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 boot identity change and recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id changed 636556ce...->1c3722de...; post-reboot mariadb active, wsrep size=3 Synced, all 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 boot identity change and recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id changed 254597f8...->688be2f3...; post-reboot mariadb active, wsrep size=3 Synced, all 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 boot identity change and recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id changed 7ef78016...->8dda4d7f...; post-reboot mariadb active, wsrep size=3 Primary/Synced, all 5 rows intact, quorum preserved throughout (only one node restarted at a time)
